title: Direct Lake: tables a Power BI model reads straight from OneLake
objectives: Tell Import, DirectQuery and Direct Lake apart
Shape Gold tables a Direct Lake model reads well: a star, real tables, compact files
Build a date dimension with a whole-number key, and a fact table that finds it

exercises.prompt: Make dim_date (date_key INTEGER like 20260301, date DATE, year, month; one row per order date) and fact_orders (order_id, date_key INTEGER, customer_id, amount DECIMAL(12,2)), where every order finds its date.
hints: year(d) * 10000 + month(d) * 100 + day(d) gives 20260301, and runs in DuckDB, Spark SQL and T-SQL alike. CAST it AS INTEGER: DuckDB's year() is a BIGINT.
Build dim_date from SELECT DISTINCT order_date FROM orders, so every date appears once.
fact_orders computes date_key from order_date the same way, so every key is in dim_date.
